item: Two row-to-dict conversions in the keyword log export type-check clean under the lock's SQLAlchemy as well as the newest
refs: R318; R283; red found by OSM
summary: mypy 2.4.0 reported two arg-type errors (keywords.py source article counts and source names) on SQLAlchemy 2.0.51, the version requirements.lock pins, where Result.fetchall() is a Sequence[Row[Any]] that dict() will not take as pairs; on SQLAlchemy 2.1.4, which CI's unbounded pyproject resolve installs, the file was clean, so CI never saw it. Both are dict comprehensions that unpack each row now; the rows are read the same way. mypy over all of src/ is clean under both versions (729 files). Found by OSM; the CI-against-the-lock-install question is a separate proposal.
